VARDE

180minutes
58solder joints
difficulty

A solar Meshtastic relay you solder yourself

Heat the pad and the pin together for two seconds. Feed solder into the joint, not onto the iron. Take the solder away first, then the iron.

Strip 3 mm, twist the strands, and tin the end before you solder it to a pad.

Unplug USB and disconnect any battery before you solder or change a wire. Work on a surface that does not burn, and wash your hands after handling solder.

21VARDE-WIRE-1

Before you switch it on

  1. Look. Every joint is a shiny cone. No solder touches a neighbouring pad. No stray strands of wire.
  2. These must not beep. Set the multimeter to continuity and probe each pair. A beep means a short: find it before you plug in.
    PANEL_INGNDCELL_PLUSGNDLOAD_OUTGNDSWITCHED_INGND3V3GND
  3. These must beep. Probe the two ends of every connection.
    PANEL_INPanel + · Charger VBUS
    GNDPanel - · Charger GND.2 · Cell - · Controller GND · Radio GND · Meter GND · Climate GND
    CELL_PLUSCell + · Meter VIN-
    CHARGER_BATTMeter VIN+ · Charger LIPO
    THERMNTC 1 · Charger THERM
    THERM_GNDNTC 2 · Charger GND.3
    LOAD_OUTCharger OUT · Switch COM
    SWITCHED_INSwitch A · Controller 5V
    3V3Controller 3V3 · Radio VCC · Meter VIN · Climate VCC
    LORA_SCKController 10 · Radio SCK
    LORA_MISOController 6 · Radio MISO
    LORA_MOSIController 7 · Radio MOSI
    LORA_CSController 8 · Radio NSS
    LORA_RESETController 5 · Radio NRST
    LORA_BUSYController 4 · Radio BUSY
    LORA_DIO1Controller 3 · Radio DIO1
    LORA_RXENController 2 · Radio RXEN
    LORA_TXENRadio DIO2 · Radio TXEN
    I2C_SDAController 1 · Meter SDA · Climate SDA
    I2C_SCLController 0 · Meter SCL · Climate SCL
  4. Plug in. Nothing gets warm, nothing smells. If something does, unplug at once and go back to step 2.
  5. Flash the bring-up test. It reports every part it can find before you load the real firmware.pio run -e bringup -t upload && pio device monitor
22VARDE-WIRE-1

Varde is built

Varde is the outdoor, solar-powered node of a small Meshtastic network: an ESP32-C3 and an SX1262 LoRa radio that relay text messages between handheld nodes where they cannot reach each other. A 6 V panel keeps an 18650 cell charged, a current sensor reports how much energy goes in and out, and an internal humidity sensor tells you whether the box is taking on condensation. It runs the stock Meshtastic firmware for the ESP32-C3 SuperMini DIY target; the wiring follows that target's pin map exactly.
